text:
Morgan: Quick heads-up 1Q access-review dry run proposal. Want to exercise entitlement prune pipeline on low-risk service accounts + validate the KMS audit signals and post-change evidence capture. Thoughts?
Priya: +1. Recommend we run as a dry-run first (no actual role removals) and produce a CSV of proposed changes so app owners can review.
Tej: Agree. Can we use the `entitlement-scan` job to generate candidates and include justification heuristics (last-use >180d, ownerless=true, role=admin)?
Ana: We should also test the emergency rollback path for any accidental breakage. I can script a one-command rebind: `./scripts/rebind-owner --from=automation --to=owner@redwood.com --dry-run`
Jane-SRE: Need exact log lines to look for. KMS usage we expect to see in Cloud Audit Logs as `methodName="cryptoKeyVersions.asymmetricSign"` with `authenticationInfo.principalEmail` set to the principal. Also capture `serviceName` and `resourceName`.
Priya: Can audit-bot create a checklist so owners ack proposed removals? I want a gate where owner must respond within 72h or change gets queued for manual review.
audit-bot: Created ticket SEC-ACCESS-DRYRUN-2026, checklist template attached. Will add `owner_ack_deadline` label and notify owners via grouped email.
Tej: For the dry-run, outputs: CSV columns = [principal, role, last_seen_iso, owner_email, proposed_action, evidence_link]. We should sign artifacts with `gpg` so we have tamper-proof evidence.
Ana: Also capture RBAC policy diffs as unified diff. Example command to produce diffs: `kubectl auth reconcile --export-diff --subject <principal> > diffs/<principal>.patch`
Morgan: Ops impact question: will removing admin-like roles ripple into provisioning flows? Can we add a canary: only apply removals for service accounts with `env=staging` and `tag=prune-ok` first?
Jane-SRE: Yes, do canary. Also we9ll validate metrics: failed deployments count, support tickets with label `access-prune-regression`. If any of those spike above threshold in 24h, auto-revert and escalate.
ops-bot: Canary run scheduled for 2026-07-21T16:00Z targeting 7 principals in staging. Will run dry-run first then apply after manual GO.
Priya: Post-prune audit: ensure KMS key ACLs unchanged and that any ephemeral keys created during test are removed. Add a log-parity check: compare entries in Cloud Audit Logs vs our entitlement event stream; diff should be empty.
Tej: I9ll add a Prometheus alert for `entitlement_prune_failures_total > 0` and a log-based metric for missing KMS events: `absent(metric_kms_event_count{job="entitlement"})`
Ana: Ownership handoff: owners get 3 business days to comment. After that, security team will review manually. Document the exception path for business-critical principals.
Morgan: OK. Next steps: Tej produce candidate CSV by EOD Tue; Ana + Jane-SRE validate rollback and log queries; Priya coordinate owner notifications; audit-bot attach checklist. We9ll reconvene Wed 10am PT for final signoff.
Jane-SRE: Posting sample Cloud Logging query for KMS parity: `resource.type="cloud_kms_key" protoPayload.methodName:asymmetricSign protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:([email protected])`
Priya: Thanks. If anyone is unavailable for Wed 10am, ping me. We9ll treat the dry-run as low-noise but keep all channels open in case owners flag regressions. :white_check_mark:
